frozen_market.question: Will Mark Carney be TIME Person of the Year 2026?
rule_facts: Yes requires Carney explicitly named TIME Person of the Year 2026; if multiple people named, each qualifies.
If a group/concept is selected, Carney can qualify if directly associated and pictured on an official announcing cover, or explicitly named.
Specific concepts/entities qualify only if synonymous with the announced choice; vague labels use the feature article to define meaning/equivalence.
If no announcement by 2027-06-30 11:59 PM ET, No. Resolution source: official TIME cover(s), with feature article also usable.

dated_primary_facts.fact: Title names The Architects of AI as Person of the Year 2025; page metadata describes their economic, geopolitical, and social influence. This is 2025 context, not a 2026 announcement.

Explainer says two commissioned artists, Peter Crowther and Jason Seiler, created images illustrating the AI choice and man-vs-machine duality. Static page includes cover-art imagery; this capture does not independently identify all depicted persons.

TIME says each year its editors name the person/people with the most influence in the previous 12 months; 2025 choice was The Architects of AI. Page says living-person status is tradition, not a requirement.
Official profile identifies Mark Carney as Canada's 24th Prime Minister and says he became Liberal Party leader and was sworn in as PM in March 2025.
